CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 24

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 11

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 16

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
